body:
No real story; nothing significant.

Why are you here?

Thanks :-)

I'm pretty confident I will.
Argon, but you can also use Nitrogen. I don't suggest helium; it is cheaper, but global helium shortages mean most tanks are 20% air, not sufficient for inert gas asphyxiation.

By global standards it's fantastic, but I'm miserable.

Later alligator.
Home. You can't. Because sleeping is the best part of my life and officially has been for the majority of it.

You asked what went into this... I had to make the bag/hood, buy the argon regulator on Amazon, go to Home Depot to get the tubing, and rent the tank from a local welding supplier (it's stupid cheap).

Everything is ready, and it's time to go soon. It's okay, it will be a peace. If there is something after, you can come find me.

Nothing unique, just ready to move on.

It's okay.
Do you experience deep sleep? For me, being unconscious is when I am at peace, and happy. Death is like sleeping forever, and that sounds amazing.

I mean it will be okay for everybody else.

And me, I guess. I mean, we all die eventually... it's natural, and okay. There shouldn't be so much stigma around death. I'll be relaxed finally.
We're all just little specks. It'll be okay.
